name: help-scout
description: Reads and writes the documented Help Scout Mailbox API v2 surface: conversations and threads, customers and their email/phone/chat/social/website contact records, organizations, mailboxes and mailbox configuration, users, teams, tags, webhooks, and workflows, through OAuth2 client-credentials authentication.

risk.read: external Help Scout API read of conversation, thread, customer, organization, mailbox, team, tag, webhook, workflow, and user data
risk.write: external Help Scout Mailbox API mutation of conversations, threads, customers and their contact records, organizations, users, teams, tags, webhooks, and workflows; 18 of the 65 write actions are permanent DELETEs that remove Help Scout records outright, including delete_customer, delete_conversation, delete_attachment, delete_email, and delete_phone
risk.approval: required for every write action; reverse ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, then execute, and the 18 destructive delete actions additionally require a typed confirmation
